5400: Stand tall and grip the stick with both hands, one end held high.
Reach the stick overhead and lean gently away from the higher hand.
Keep your hips square and your ribs from flaring out.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along your side and back.
Return to upright and switch sides.
5401: Stand tall and hold the stick behind your back with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and lift the stick slightly away from your body.
Stay tall and avoid arching your lower back.
5402: Hold a stick in both hands and step into a long lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch at the front of the back hip.
Step back and repeat on the other leg.
5403: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rest a stick across your upper back.
Hold it with both hands and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your upper body slowly to one side.
Pause for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-12 slow turns and keep your knees soft.
5404: Stand tall and hold the stick in front of you with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the stick overhead.
Carry it back behind your body in a smooth arc.
Return the same way to the start.
Repeat for 8-10 slow passes and narrow your grip as you get more flexible.
5405: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your chest open.
Bend slowly to one side without leaning forward.
Return to center and bend to the other side.
5406: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Bend sideways to one side and hold briefly.
Then turn the torso forward and fold from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then rise slowly.
5407: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Raise the stick overhead with straight arms.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds.
Press up through your feet to stand.
5408: Hold the stick across your chest or in front with both hands and step into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Twist your torso over the front leg.
Untwist, step back and switch legs.
5445: Stand tall with your hands on your hips and feet hip-width apart.
Exhale fully until your lungs feel empty.
Pull your belly button toward your spine and hold it there.
Hold for 10-20 seconds without breathing in deeply.
Relax and breathe normally, then repeat.
5447: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms extend.
5448: Sit in the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grip the handles overhand with arms straight.
Pull your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows much.
Let your shoulder blades spread slowly.
5449: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping them close to your torso.
Let your elbows travel slightly back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
5450: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
5451: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, loaded as the exercise requires.
Keep your shins roughly vertical with the knees kept slightly forward of the hips.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips up until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second at the top without arching your back.
5458: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
5460: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.
5466: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold for a couple of seconds.
5469: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.
5470: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and clip it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the stack, hold the frame and keep your torso tall.
Sweep the working leg out and slightly back, leading with the heel.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without leaning.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
5471: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms on your chest and let your upper back round slightly.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and lift until your body is nearly in line.
Stop before overarching and repeat with control.
5472: Lie on your back with hands under your hips or by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor.
Curl your hips up slightly as you bring your knees toward your chest.
Lower your legs slowly without letting your lower back arch.
5473: Grab neutral-grip handles about shoulder width apart and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull your chest toward your hands until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to a full hang.
5474: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.
5476: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Place one foot slightly ahead of the other.
Drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, keeping your chin tucked.
Lower under control, and swap the foot position on the next set.
5477: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms and shoulders pushed down.
Keep your legs together and slightly bent or straight.
Raise your legs until they reach hip height or higher, curling your pelvis.
5478: Stand with one foot on the bosu dome and the other behind you.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot and bring the back knee up high.
Land softly and balanced, then repeat.
5479: Grip the bar with hands a few centimetres apart, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and engage your shoulders.
Pull yourself up until your chin passes the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Keep your core tight and avoid swinging.
5480: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and loop the band around the ball of that foot.
Hold the band ends with both hands and sit tall.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your knee straight.
5481: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Keep your heel down and slide the foot forward along the floor.
Pull it back, letting the heel lift slightly toward the end.
Move smoothly through a comfortable range.
5482: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms ready.
Hop up and forward or in place using your ankle and knee.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Stay balanced and keep your hips level.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
5483: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
5484: Sit with one forefoot on a raised edge and weight on that knee.
Lower the heel for a full stretch.
Press up onto the ball of your foot as high as possible.
Finish your reps and switch legs.
5496: Stand with heels on a low plate, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your chest tall and elbows pointing down.
Squat down between your knees as deep as comfortable.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
5497: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell beside one hand and feet wide.
Brace your core and keep hips level.
Reach the free hand under your body and grab the dumbbell.
Pass it across to the other side and place it down.
5498: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.
